description: This file defines the AccountingRuleRepository interface which extends Spring Data JPA repositories for managing AccountingRule entities, including a custom query to retrieve rules by office ID.

classes.name: AccountingRuleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for the AccountingRule entity, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: getAccountingRuleByOfficeId
